scripts.summary: 🎾 Racket Rivals Script 🎾 ATENTION! This script is open source. I will not update it.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")

local RF = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local base = require(RF:WaitForChild("Classes"):WaitForChild("RacketHandler"):WaitForChild("Moves"):WaitForChild("RacketMoveBase"))

local size = 28

if getgenv().Hitbox_Expander then getgenv().Hitbox_Expander() end

local old = getgenv().DidHit or base.DidHit
getgenv().DidHit = old

local ball = Instance.new("Part")
ball.Name = "hitbox"
ball.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
ball.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (size * 2)
ball.Transparency = 0.8
ball.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
ball.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
ball.Anchored = true
ball.CanCollide = false
ball.CanQuery = false
ball.CanTouch = false
ball.CastShadow = false
ball.Parent = workspace

local con
con = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local char = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	if char then
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			ball.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
			return
		end
	end
	ball.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
end)

base.DidHit = function(self, pos, radius)
	return old(self, pos, size)
end

getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = function()
	if con then
		con:Disconnect()
		con = nil
	end
	if ball then
		ball:Destroy()
	end
	base.DidHit = old
	getgenv().Hitbox_Expander = nil
end

scripts.title: headless fe real 2026
scripts.author: dontgetme
scripts.summary: makes your head invisible in every game
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
 
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local connection
 
local function makeLocalHeadless(character)
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
        connection = nil
    end
 
    local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
    if not head then
        return
    end
 
    local function hideHead()
        head.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
 
        for _, child in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Decal") then
                child.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
    end
 
    hideHead()
 
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not character.Parent or not head.Parent then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
            return
        end
 
        hideHead()
    end)
end
 
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(makeLocalHeadless)
 
if player.Character then
    task.spawn(function()
        makeLocalHeadless(player.Character)
    end)
end
